bars.name: Infinity Bar
bars.description: Located at the base of the central atrium, serving Italian aperitifs, espresso, and cocktails amidst live musical performances.

bars.name: Galleria Bellissima Bar
bars.description: Centrally located along the indoor promenade beneath the 80-meter LED sky dome.

bars.name: Masters of the Sea
bars.description: Authentic British-style pub featuring wooden paneling, a live band stage, 12 draft beers, and over 47 international bottled beers. Serves traditional pub fare such as fish and chips.

bars.name: TV Studio & Bar
bars.description: A high-tech, multi-purpose lounge and broadcast bar featuring karaoke, live music, late-night dancing, and interactive game shows.

bars.name: Champagne Bar
bars.description: A luxury venue serving premium cold-pressed seafood and caviar plates alongside premium champagnes and sparkling wines. Features an illuminated panel wall with approximately 500,000 Swarovski crystals per square meter.

bars.name: Edge Cocktail Bar
bars.description: Pre-dinner cocktail bar situated on the promenade gallery overlooking the central atrium.

bars.name: Imperial Casino Bar
bars.description: Conveniently integrated into the casino floor serving players table-side and at the bar counter.

bars.name: Atmosphere Bar North & South
bars.description: Twin poolside bars serving tropical cocktails, frozen beverages, beers, and quick snacks around the Atmosphere Pool.

bars.name: Horizon Bar
bars.description: Outdoor aft bar looking out directly onto the ship's wake with sunset cocktail service.
